extracted.intended_audience: education researchers and prospective Spencer Foundation grant applicants
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance for researchers considering Spencer Foundation funding; describes the foundation's mission and the broad kinds of projects it supports (research, training, field-building) rather than detailed application criteria. Useful for prospective applicants deciding fit and which program to explore further.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support high-quality, innovative research on education, broadly conceived
rubrics_metrics.description: We support high-quality, innovative research on education, broadly conceived.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the primary statement of what the Foundation funds; applicants should orient projects toward high quality and innovation within the broad field of education. The site organizes funding into program types (Research Grants, Training Grants, Field Building Grants) which applicants should consult to determine fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invest in education research that cultivates learning and transforms lives
rubrics_metrics.description: The Spencer Foundation invests in education research that cultivates learning and transforms lives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation's mission emphasizes research that (implicitly) has impact on learning and life outcomes. The homepage highlights exemplar questions the Foundation cares about (e.g., role of education research in creating a better society; ensuring equitable learning opportunities; recruiting and supporting school leaders and teachers; creating richer public conversations about education), which indicate thematic priorities applicants should address.
